records.text: Adding this job breaks the required workflow contract test: `tests/fm-ci-workflow.test.sh:73-78,151-159` requires every CI job to be listed in exactly one timeout tier, but `pi-latest` is absent from `NORMAL_TIER_JOBS`. The portable suite will therefore fail even though this job declares the normal-tier timeout. Add `pi-latest` to that inventory alongside this workflow change.
